---
name: ⚖️ Balancing Issue
about: Suggest adjustments to game mechanics, values, rates, or system logic.

---

### Current Mechanic / Value
Describe the current state of the mechanic or system that feels unbalanced.

### The Problem
Why is this a problem? (e.g., too easy, too expensive, overpowered, underpowered).

### Proposed Change
What exact changes or numbers do you suggest to make it balanced?

### Additional Context
Any extra data, comparisons, or reasons to support your suggestion.
